hypothesis.statement: In the Tukey HSD post-hoc of the vertical-GRF dynamic range across GaitRec's five gait classes, healthy controls differ significantly from all four pathology classes while the pathology classes do not differ from one another; the newly-authored tukeyHSD reproduces base R stats::TukeyHSD and scipy.stats.tukey_hsd to machine precision.

analysis_plan.dataset: GaitRec (Horsak et al. 2020); Tukey HSD of the vertical-GRF dynamic range (peak1 - trough via PhysioMoCap::grfLandmarks) across the five gait classes

decision.threshold: descriptive: tukeyHSD equals base R TukeyHSD and scipy.stats.tukey_hsd to machine precision (|diff| < 1e-9); all four healthy-vs-pathology pairs are significant (p < 0.05) and none of the six pathology-pathology pairs are
